quote_zh: 步骤a：取1.1mol(134.2g)三氟乙醇钠，1.2mol(48g)氢氧化钠，1.0mol(318g)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺基苯甲酸甲酯(化合物I)，1000mL N,N-二甲基甲酰胺加入到反应器中，然后30℃保温5小时后，将反应液中的N,N-二甲基甲酰胺减压蒸除后，将残液加入300mL水中，用35％的盐酸调pH至弱酸性，冷却结晶，过滤，水洗，干燥得化合物II，称重得314.8g，收率91％，其中，N,N-二甲基甲酰胺作为反应溶剂，还可以用己烷、环己烷、苯、甲苯、二甲苯、二氯甲烷、1,2-二氯乙烷、氯仿、1,4-二氧六环、乙醚、四氢呋喃、乙腈中的一种或多种代替。
arithmetic_check: Charges: 三氟乙醇钠 134.2 g / 1.1 mol implies 122.0 against C2H2F3ONa = 122.02, closes. 氢氧化钠 48 g / 1.2 mol implies 40.0 against NaOH = 40.00, closes. 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺基苯甲酸甲酯 318 g / 1.0 mol implies 318.0 against C10H10BrClO4S = 341.60, low by 23.60 (6.9％). The shortfall matches no single atom or fragment of that structure, so it is recorded as printed with no reconstruction offered. Flag: molar_mass_inconsistent. Product closure: limiting input 1.0 mol; product 314.8 g at the printed 91％ implies 345.93 g/mol. This section never says what 化合物II is, but the specification's summary at line 95 names it 2-氯-3-三氟乙氧甲基-4-甲磺基苯甲酸, the free acid C11H10ClF3O5S = 346.70, and 0.91 x 346.70 = 315.50 g against 314.8 g printed, that is 99.8％ of the yield-implied figure and 90.8％ of the 1.0 mol theoretical maximum against a printed 91％. CLOSES. Against the methyl ester C12H12ClF3O5S = 360.73 it would not: 0.91 x 360.73 = 328.26 g would be expected for 314.8 g printed. So no mass_balance_implausible is raised, and the closure is itself the arithmetic evidence that the methyl ester is hydrolysed in this pot, which is why the record is one-pot with reaction_class hydrolysis rather than a single nucleophilic substitution. The 1.2 mol of sodium hydroxide against 1.0 mol of ester is consistent with a stoichiometric saponification rather than a catalytic role. Note the asymmetry worth carrying to A5: the reactant mass/mole pair is 6.9％ low against its own name while the product mass/mole/yield triple closes, so the defect is localised to the compound I charge and is not a uniform scaling of the whole example.

quote_zh: 步骤b：取1mol上述反应所得的化合物II，溶解在1000mL的1,2-二氯乙烷中，然后在5-10℃温度条件下，半小时内加入含1.2mol(117.6g)1,3-环己二酮(化合物III)和1.2mol(194.6g)缩合剂CDI以及1.2mol(121.2g)三乙胺，再在5-10℃温度条件下搅拌反应8小时，然后经过水洗、减压浓缩、加甲醇打浆、过滤、干燥得到成品环磺酮(化合物IV)366.4g，纯度96.5％，收率86.3％，其中，1,2-二氯乙烷作为反应溶剂，还可以用己烷、环己烷、N,N-二甲基甲酰胺、苯、甲苯、二甲苯、二氯甲烷、氯仿、1,4-二氧六环、乙醚、四氢呋喃、乙腈中的一种或多种代替。
arithmetic_check: Charges: 1,3-环己二酮 117.6 g / 1.2 mol implies 98.0 against C6H8O2 = 112.13; 1.2 mol of the named compound would be 134.55 g. Flag: molar_mass_inconsistent. The 98.0 is not a one-off: Example 5 prints 1 mol as 98 g and Example 3 prints 1.5 mol as 147 g, both 98.0, while Example 2 prints 1.3 mol as 145.6 g, which is 112.0 and correct. The patent therefore uses two different weights for the same compound in different examples. 缩合剂CDI 194.6 g / 1.2 mol implies 162.17 against C7H6N4O = 162.15, closes. 三乙胺 121.2 g / 1.2 mol implies 101.0 against C6H15N = 101.19, closes. Product closure: limiting input 1 mol of 化合物II; product tembotrione C17H16ClF3O6S = 440.82; theoretical maximum 440.82 g; at the printed 86.3％ that is 380.42 g; but 366.4 g is printed, which is 83.1％ of theory. The printed mass is below the theoretical maximum, so it is not the mass that is impossible; it is the mass and the yield together, which imply 424.57 g/mol, a value matching no species in this reaction. The printed purity makes it worse rather than better: 366.4 g at 96.5％ is 353.58 g of tembotrione, that is 0.802 mol, an 80.2％ yield rather than 86.3％. DOES NOT CLOSE. Flag: mass_balance_implausible. For scale: step a isolated 314.8 g at 91％ of 1.0 mol, about 0.91 mol, but this step charges 1 mol of that material, more than the preceding step produced. Flag: scale_discontinuity. 1,3-cyclohexanedione at 1.2 mol against 1 mol of the acid is 1.2 equivalents and CDI likewise 1.2, both within the 1-1.3:1 and 1-2:1 ratios the specification claims at line 116, so no flag on the stoichiometry itself. Numbers recorded exactly as printed.
